# Korean voice commands. Most lines are from the vendor's published Korean command list (used as a coverage checklist);
# lines the list lacks were translated for this project and have NOT been reviewed by a native speaker.
# Format: English => Korean. {braces} mark the variable part; tests remove the braces.
